Module 01 / AdDU Journey

Relishing My Journey at AdDU

A reflection on growth, empathy, and the lessons learned throughout my years at Ateneo de Davao University — a place that shaped who I am.

About Me

Who I Am

I am Ben Daniel Robiños, a graduate of Ateneo de Davao University. My years at AdDU were more than just an academic pursuit — they were a season of becoming. I came in with ambition and left with something far greater: empathy, perspective, and a deeper understanding of what it means to truly connect with others.

I believe that growth happens not just in classrooms, but in conversations, in failures, and in the quiet moments of reflection. This portfolio is a record of that growth — honest, personal, and deeply grateful.

A Message

To the People
Who Made Me

To every one of you who shared a classroom, a laugh, a late-night review session, or even just a quiet moment in the hallway — thank you. You may not have realized it then, but each of you left something in me that I will carry for the rest of my life.

You taught me what it looks like to be generous without being asked, to show up for others even when it is hard, and to find joy in the ordinary days. In a place as big as AdDU, you made it feel like home.

I am grateful not just for the memories we built, but for the person I became because of you. As we each walk our own paths forward, I hope you know that your kindness mattered — and that I will never forget it.

With a full heart, Ben Daniel

Module 02 / Conversion

Questions
& Answers

Honest reflections on who I was, what changed me, and who I am becoming — one question at a time.

01
Question

Who was I back then?

Reflection

I was someone who focused more on myself and my own goals, without really thinking deeply about others. I cared about my responsibilities, but I did not always pay attention to how others felt. I usually interacted with people on a surface level and did not go deeper. Looking back, I can say I lacked awareness when it came to meaningful connections.

02
Question

What left a mark on you?

Reflection

I learned the most about truly seeing and valuing other people beyond surface-level interactions. It made me realize that every person has their own story that deserves respect and understanding. It left a mark because it challenged how I usually think and act toward others — it opened my eyes to the importance of empathy in everyday life.

03
Question

A particular instance of transformation?

Reflection

There was a class activity where we had to listen deeply to someone else's story without interrupting or judging. I realized it was actually difficult to fully focus on another person. As I listened, I began to understand their feelings more clearly. That moment helped me become more patient and more open-minded. Since then, I have been trying to listen better and be more present.

04
Question

Who are you most thankful for?

Reflection

I am most thankful for my classmates and teachers who showed kindness and openness in simple ways. They made me feel that small actions can have a big impact on others. I appreciate how they listened, supported, and respected different perspectives. I plan to be more intentional in how I treat people and build relationships going forward.

Module 03 / Passion Plan

My Vision for
the Future

01

Personal Mission Statement

I'm still figuring out who I want to be, but as an IT student about to graduate, I want to become someone skilled, responsible, and willing to keep learning. I know technology keeps changing, so I want to improve myself and not give up easily when things get hard or confusing. What drives me is my future and my family, because I want to make them proud and have a stable career someday. I want to live by honesty, respect, and hard work, especially in the field I'm entering. In the future, I hope I can use my skills to help others, even in simple ways, and build a life I can be proud of.

02

Prayer for My Future Self

Dear God, I pray for my future as I finish my journey as an IT student and start a new chapter in my life. I hope You guide me in reaching my dreams and help me find the right path for my career. I know things won't always be easy, so please give me strength, patience, and courage to face challenges and not give up. I pray that I continue to grow not just in my skills but also as a person, becoming more responsible, humble, and hardworking. Guide my decisions so I won't lose my way and remind me to always trust in You. Amen.

03

10–20 Year Passion Plan

In the next 10–20 years, I see myself working in the IT field, hopefully in a stable job where I can use my skills and continue learning new technologies. I want to start by gaining experience, improving my skills, and maybe getting certifications to grow in my career. Over time, I hope to achieve bigger goals like getting a higher position, having a stable income, and possibly helping my family financially. In the future, I hope to build a simple but meaningful life, where I am stable, able to support my family, and still growing as a person.

"

The best journeys are not measured in years, but in the moments, the people, and the person you became along the way.
